# Meshy 3D Printing

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — a 3D-printing workflow for Muse: generate a model from text or a photo, scale and orient it, run printability analysis and repair, then hand you print-ready files with a slicer handoff — including multicolor prints and Creative Lab product templates (lamps, keychains, figures). By @meshy-dev, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: local preparation steps are free, but cloud generation and analysis consume Meshy credits beyond the free quota; login uses a device code you approve yourself in your browser — never paste credentials in chat; analysis and repair reports do not guarantee a model is actually printable — check wall thickness and supports in your slicer. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
